Overview

Konya is a city in Konya with a population of 2,250,000. The spiritual home of the Whirling Dervishes, a conservative city with Seljuk architecture and agricultural wealth. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 270 sunny days a year. The population skews young, with a median age of 33.0.
